description: This file contains image resizing functions and filter implementations for the Skia graphics library, including filter evaluation functions, resize filter class, and resize methods.

classes.name: ResizeFilter
classes.description: Encapsulates the computation and storage of convolution filters used for image resizing.

methods.name: CeilInt
methods.description: Returns the ceiling of a float as an integer.

methods.name: FloorInt
methods.description: Returns the floor of a float as an integer.

methods.name: ResizeFilter::ResizeFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes filter parameters based on resize method and dimensions.

methods.name: ResizeFilter::ComputeFilters
methods.description: Computes convolution filter coefficients for resizing.

methods.name: ResizeMethodToAlgorithmMethod
methods.description: Converts general resize method to specific algorithm method.

methods.name: ImageOperations::Resize
methods.description: Resizes an image from a source pixmap with specified method and dimensions.
